mapper.update: INSERT INTO classification (merge_key, code_value, code_name, japanese) VALUES (#{mergeKey}, #{codeValue}, #{codeName}, #{japanese}) ON CONFLICT (merge_key) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO patent_classification (company_id, patent_id, classification_id, inserted_at, updated_at, deleted, sync_id) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{patentId}, #{classificationId}, now(), now(), false, #{syncId}::uuid) ON CONFLICT (company_id, patent_id, classification_id) DO UPDATE SET deleted = false, updated_at = now(), sync_id = EXCLUDED.sync_id
UPDATE patent_classification SET deleted = true, updated_at = now() WHERE deleted = false AND company_id = #{companyId} AND patent_id = #{patentId} AND sync_id != #{syncId}::uuid

UPDATE patent_classification pc SET deleted = true, updated_at = now() FROM company_patent cp WHERE pc.patent_id = cp.patent_id AND pc.company_id = #{companyId} AND cp.company_id = #{companyId} AND cp.deleted = true AND pc.deleted = false
